description: This is a Python source file implementing an in-memory WebSocket connection manager class called RealtimeManager. It handles WebSocket connections, subscriptions, disconnections, and message publishing, primarily for real-time updates in a dashboard or workspace context.

classes.name: ChannelKey
classes.description: A data class representing a unique key for a WebSocket channel, composed of a channel type and a UUID.

classes.name: RealtimeManager
classes.description: A WebSocket connection manager handling connect, disconnect, subscribe, and publish functionalities.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the RealtimeManager with an asyncio lock and a dictionary of channels.

methods.name: None disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket)
methods.description: Removes a WebSocket from all subscribed channels and cleans up empty channels.

methods.name: None subscribe(self, websocket: WebSocket, *, channel_type: str, channel_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Subscribes a WebSocket to a specific channel identified by channel_type and channel_id.

methods.name: None publish(self, *, channel_type: str, channel_id: uuid.UUID, message: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all WebSocket clients subscribed to a specific channel.

ctags.name: connect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def connect(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: disconnect
ctags.pattern: /^    async def disconnect(self, websocket: WebSocket) -> None:$/

ctags.name: publish
ctags.pattern: /^    async def publish(self, *, channel_type: str, channel_id: uuid.UUID, message: Dict[str, Any]/
ctags.signature: (self, *, channel_type: str, channel_id: uuid.UUID, message: Dict[str, Any])

ctags.pattern: /^    async def subscribe(self, websocket: WebSocket, *, channel_type: str, channel_id: uuid.UUID)/
